h1: Handmade knives from a German bladesmith
lead: In his workshop near Heilbronn, bladesmith Andreas Ulbrich makes damascus knives, kitchen knives, hunting knives and folding knives. Many are one of a kind – so price and availability are confirmed personally.

items.x: Damascus steel is made by forge-welding different steels together. After grinding and etching, the layers show a pattern that makes every blade unique.
Chef's knife, gyuto, santoku, nakiri, paring knife, bread, filleting and boning knives. Which shape suits you depends on what and how you cut – Andreas will help you choose.
Fixed-blade hunting knives and folding knives, including the numbered damascus folding knife of the [Edition 100](/en/folding-knife/).
Blade and handle designed as a whole, each piece made only once. If nothing available fits, a [custom knife](/en/custom-knives/) is possible.
Email or call with what you are looking for
Confirmation of price, availability and – outside Germany – shipping costs
Payment by bank transfer, or cash or card when collecting in person
Every knife comes with a care booklet and a care product, free of charge. On top comes our [lifetime sharpening guarantee](/en/warranty/): free resharpening as often as needed.

faq.q: Do you make santoku, gyuto and nakiri knives?
faq.a: Yes. These shapes are available and can also be made as custom knives.

faq.q: Why is there no fixed price for some knives?
faq.a: Many knives are one of a kind. Price and availability are therefore confirmed personally.

faq.q: Do you ship knives outside Germany?
faq.a: Yes, if you cover all costs involved – shipping, insurance and any fees. Alternatively, you can collect your knife from the workshop in person.

faq.q: Do you offer sharpening and repair?
faq.a: Yes. Knives can be brought to the workshop or sent by post for sharpening, repair or a new handle.
